browser: Chrome on macOS; isolated automated profile
limitations: Canvas rendering of actual saved geometry, not in-browser reconstruction or live capture. Avignon displays all 11,307 saved points; TUM deterministically subsamples the 45,424-point stereo cloud. JSON files record source PLY hashes, full counts and displayed counts. Coordinates have arbitrary SfM scale. Avignon-derived geometry is CC BY-NC 3.0 (noncommercial); TUM-derived data is CC BY 4.0. These rights are separate from the new viewer source license.
